fusions.name: Hundredfold Hurl
fusions.desc: Hurls you at an enemy up to 6.5 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 2 times as much at maximum range, and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Mountain Landing
fusions.desc: Slams down in a ring, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Catapult Step
fusions.desc: Launches you 5 tiles forward. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Overbalancing
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying a condition, you deal 15% more damage.
